curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As Santa Anna's forces encircle the compound, Crockett and Bowie face impossible odds to hold the fortified mission.
curatedMovie.description: In 1836 San Antonio, Texan and Tejano fighters led by Davy Crockett and Jim Bowie make a determined stand at the Alamo against the advancing army of Mexican dictator Santa Anna.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, tense, and deliberate historical drama demanding engaged viewing across a sweeping wartime siege.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This historical drama centers the 1836 standoff at the Alamo between men led by Crockett and Bowie and Santa Anna’s forces.
